description: Platform peak anchors measured on the deployment Orin (AGX Orin 64GB, MAXN) via arm64/eval/microbench_orin.py — the achievable (not datasheet) roofline endpoints used by docs/roofline_analysis.md.

results.dram_copy_note: 2 x 1 GiB fp16 copy, best of 10 reps; 83% of the 204.8 GB/s datasheet figure
results.fp16_gemm_note: 8192^3, best of 10; ~51% of the ~42.5 dense TFLOPS derived from the datasheet (sparse/2)
results.int8_gemm_note: torch._int_mm 8192^3, best of 10; measures SLOWER than FP16 in this path (a torch/cuBLASLt kernel-selection artifact on sm_87, not the platform INT8 ceiling: TRT IMMA convs reach 1.78x on the backbone, roofline 3.1)
results.tiny_kernel_note: 1000 back-to-back 1k-element fp16 adds, per-kernel launch+execute floor; x481 kernels per head inference = ~13.5 ms fixed cost

usage: Anchor values for docs/roofline_analysis.md sections 2 and 3.2; regenerate with: LD_LIBRARY_PATH=<TRT lib> python3 arm64/eval/microbench_orin.py
